**title: 8 Mistakes that Kill small channels (2026 Algorithm Update)**  
Since 2018 I've launched over 50 YouTube channels, pulled hundreds of millions of views, and made over $2 million in ad revenue. These are 8 mistakes that might be quietly killing your channel right now. Number 5 is the one almost nobody is talking about.   
How to check if your channel is actually dead using your impressions (not views), why YouTube treats every email differently, the off-platform setup YouTube loves to see, and the AEO shift that decides whether AI cites your videos in 2026\.
